name: tree_spruce
description: Tutorial outdoors spruce, straight down: dense radial needle boughs. Tall: trunk_base (ground contact) + canopy_top (height-shifted crown).
scale_note: Brief B size 3 x 3 units = 240 x 240 art px. Collision in spruce.tscn is 20 x 14 world px (50 x 35 art). The canopy covers the larger crown; the trunk_base covers the ground contact. Pivot is the canvas centre.
